goal: Get the loan agreement and book the 20-minute review.

approved_lines.when: Asked: who are you / how did you get my number?
approved_lines.say: That's a fair question. I'm with Elite Solar Recovery. We help homeowners whose solar deal went wrong. You're welcome to look us up and call me back.
approved_lines.careful: Don't dodge. Be straight about who you are and why you are calling.
approved_lines.next: Tell them honestly how you reached them (door visit, form or list), then ask if you can explain why you called.

approved_lines.when: Asked: is this a scam?
approved_lines.say: That's a fair question and you're right to ask. We're a real company, and you're welcome to look us up before we go any further. I'll gladly wait or call you back.
approved_lines.careful: Don't get defensive. Stay calm and factual.
approved_lines.next: Offer to let them look you up, then go back to what happened with their solar.

approved_lines.when: Asked: can you cancel my contract?
approved_lines.say: I can't promise that. What I can do is go through your paperwork with you and tell you honestly what your options look like.
approved_lines.careful: Don't promise they can cancel it. Nobody can promise that.
approved_lines.next: Ask for the installation agreement, then the loan agreement.

approved_lines.when: Asked: can you cancel my loan?
approved_lines.say: Your loan is its own agreement. Let's look at it together so we know exactly what it says.
approved_lines.careful: Never promise the loan goes away.
approved_lines.next: Get the lender's name and the latest statement.

approved_lines.when: Said: the installer went out of business
approved_lines.say: That's exactly why your paperwork matters.{closure} Let's get your documents together.
approved_lines.careful: A closed installer doesn't guarantee any outcome. Don't suggest it does.
approved_lines.next: Tap "Show homeowner" to show the record, then move to Documents.

approved_lines.when: Said: their license was revoked / suspended
approved_lines.say: Let me look at the record rather than guess.{closure}{noclosure}
approved_lines.careful: Don't confirm it from memory. Only say what the record shows.
approved_lines.next: Tap "Show homeowner" if the record shows it. If not, write down what they heard and check later.

approved_lines.when: Said: they promised my bill would be $___
approved_lines.say: Can you tell me exactly what they said your payment or bill would be? Who said it, and was it in writing?
approved_lines.careful: Write down the number they say. Don't agree or disagree with it.
approved_lines.next: Put the promised number in the case file, then ask what they pay now.

approved_lines.when: Said: the system works fine but I pay too much
approved_lines.say: Then this is about the numbers. What were you told the cost would be, and what do you pay now?
approved_lines.careful: Don't dismiss it. A working system can still be a bad deal.
approved_lines.next: Go to Reality: write both numbers in the case file.

approved_lines.when: Said: the panels don't work / never turned on
approved_lines.say: That is helpful to know. When did you first notice, and has anyone come out to look at it?
approved_lines.careful: Don't diagnose the system or promise a fix.
approved_lines.next: Note it, then go to Reality: promised versus actual.

approved_lines.when: Said: I have a lease / PPA / battery, not a loan
approved_lines.say: That's a different kind of agreement, and we'll treat it that way. Do you have the lease or PPA contract and a recent bill?
approved_lines.careful: Don't assume the rules are the same. A lease or PPA is a different agreement from a loan.
approved_lines.next: Make the lease or PPA contract the first document you ask for.

approved_lines.when: Said: I want to stop paying
approved_lines.say: I can't tell you to stop paying, that could make things worse. Let's get your paperwork reviewed first, then you'll know where you stand.
approved_lines.careful: Never tell them to stop paying.
approved_lines.next: Acknowledge the frustration, then move to Documents.

approved_lines.when: Asked: can you guarantee this works?
approved_lines.say: I can't guarantee a result. What I can promise is that we'll look at your real paperwork and give you a straight answer.
approved_lines.careful: Don't use the word guarantee about the result.
approved_lines.next: Move to Close and offer the review.

approved_lines.when: Asked: will I get my money back?
approved_lines.say: I can't promise that. It depends on what's in your paperwork, so let's get your documents first.
approved_lines.careful: Never promise refunds or money back.
approved_lines.next: Move to Documents.

approved_lines.when: Said: just tell me you can get me out
approved_lines.say: I understand. I can't promise that, but I can make sure your paperwork gets a proper look.
approved_lines.careful: Don't promise an exit.
approved_lines.next: Move to Close and book the review.

approved_lines.when: Asked: what are my chances?
approved_lines.say: Every contract is different, so I can't give odds. The review looks at yours specifically.
approved_lines.careful: Never quote odds or success rates.
approved_lines.next: Move to Documents. The paperwork decides the options.

approved_lines.when: Said: I already paid it off
approved_lines.say: Okay, that's good to know. Even if the loan is paid, it's still worth looking at what you got versus what you were told. Do you have the original agreement?
approved_lines.careful: Don't assume nothing can be looked at because it is paid.
approved_lines.next: Ask for the original agreement and any sales messages.

approved_lines.when: Said: I'm on a fixed income
approved_lines.say: I hear you, every dollar counts. We'll go through the paperwork line by line so nothing gets missed.
approved_lines.careful: Never minimize their situation, and don't promise relief.
approved_lines.next: Acknowledge, then move to Documents.

approved_lines.when: Said: I'm selling my house
approved_lines.say: I can't tell you how it works if you sell, it depends on how the paperwork is written. Let's get the documents together so you can see the wording.
approved_lines.careful: Don't guess how a sale works with their agreement.
approved_lines.next: Move to Documents and ask about their timeline.

approved_lines.when: Said: the lender says I must keep paying
approved_lines.say: Your lender's agreement is separate from the solar company. I can't tell you to stop paying, and I can't change what the lender requires.
approved_lines.careful: Don't contradict the lender and don't suggest otherwise.
approved_lines.next: Move to Documents. Get the loan agreement and any lender letter.

approved_lines.when: Asked: what happens to my credit?
approved_lines.say: I understand the concern. I can't predict what will happen to your credit, and I won't guess. Let's start with your paperwork so you can make a good decision.
approved_lines.careful: Don't predict credit outcomes. That is the lender's decision.
approved_lines.next: Move to Documents.

approved_lines.when: Asked: are you lawyers?
approved_lines.say: No, we're not lawyers. We go through your contract and paperwork with you and explain where things stand.
approved_lines.careful: Never imply you are lawyers or give legal advice.
approved_lines.next: Go back to Discovery.

approved_lines.when: Said: I already tried to cancel
approved_lines.say: Okay, that is important. What happened when you tried? Do you have anything in writing?
approved_lines.careful: Don't say whether their earlier attempt was valid or not.
approved_lines.next: Ask for any letters or emails about it as documents.

approved_lines.when: Said: I was lied to / scammed
approved_lines.say: I hear you. Let's look at exactly what you signed and what you were told.
approved_lines.careful: Don't confirm fraud as a fact.
approved_lines.next: Go to Reality: promised versus actual.

approved_lines.when: Asked: can we just sue them?
approved_lines.say: That's your decision and I can't advise on it. My job is to help you get your paperwork organized so you know where you stand.
approved_lines.careful: Don't recommend or advise legal action.
approved_lines.next: Move to Documents.

approved_lines.when: Said: I don't remember what I signed
approved_lines.say: That's common, most people don't have it memorized. Do you know where the papers are kept, even if you can't read them today?
approved_lines.careful: Don't guess for them. The paperwork tells the story.
approved_lines.next: Ask them to find the loan agreement or installation contract.

approved_lines.when: Said: I don't want to send my documents
approved_lines.say: That's completely fine. You don't have to send anything. If you'd rather, we can look at it together while you hold onto the papers.
approved_lines.careful: Never pressure them. Respect the privacy concern.
approved_lines.next: Offer to look at them together on the review call.

approved_lines.when: Said: I got a letter from the lender
approved_lines.say: Thanks for telling me. What did the letter say, and is there a date on it? Please keep it, it is one of the documents we need.
approved_lines.careful: Don't interpret the letter for them. It is a document to collect.
approved_lines.next: Ask them to keep the letter and add it to the documents.

approved_lines.when: Said: my spouse handles this
approved_lines.say: That makes sense. Would it work to set a time when you're both available? It's best when everyone who signed the paperwork is on the call.
approved_lines.careful: Don't talk around the person who signed. Include them.
approved_lines.next: Ask for a time that works for both and book it.

approved_lines.when: Said: just send me information
approved_lines.say: I can do that. So the information is actually useful to you, can I ask one or two quick questions about your situation first?
approved_lines.careful: Don't let an information request replace the conversation.
approved_lines.next: Ask the questions, then book the review and send the overview after.

approved_lines.when: Said: I need to think about it
approved_lines.say: Take all the time you need, nothing has to be decided on this call. Would it help to have the review first, so you know what you're weighing up?
approved_lines.careful: Don't push past hesitation. Give space, and lock a follow-up.
approved_lines.next: Book a specific follow-up time, even a 5-minute call.

approved_lines.when: Said: call me later / bad time
approved_lines.say: No problem at all, I'll keep it short next time. What day and time works best for you?
approved_lines.careful: Don't keep them on the phone if it's a bad time.
approved_lines.next: Get an exact day and time and say it back to them.

empathy: That sounds really frustrating, and you're right to want answers.
I hear you. A lot of people feel stuck in this exact spot.
Thank you for being straight with me.
You're not the first homeowner to tell me that.
That's a lot to deal with on your own.
It makes sense that you'd feel that way.
